pages.title: Adult Link Aiming the Fairy Bow in the Forest Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Adult Link aims the Fairy Bow inside the Forest Temple in this printable coloring page, drawing an arrow across his chest with one arm fully extended. A quiver, strapped bracers, and the bow's decorated limbs add smaller sections, while ivy-covered columns and a Triforce-marked doorway frame the archer.

pages.title: Young Link Meeting Princess Zelda in the Hyrule Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Link meeting Princess Zelda in the Hyrule Castle courtyard, facing her beside a fountain beneath pointed towers and stone walls. Zelda's tiara, necklace, and patterned gown panel add fine details, while Link's cap, tunic, belt, and boots provide broader enclosed coloring areas.

pages.title: Toon Link Gliding with the Deku Leaf Near Forest Haven Coloring Page
pages.description: Toon Link glides with the Deku Leaf near Forest Haven in this printable coloring page, gripping two handles beneath the broad veined leaf above the trees. His pointed cap trails behind, while a shield, belt buckle, drifting leaves, and a small rope bridge add detail to the Wind Waker coloring sheet.

pages.title: Link Carrying a Lantern Along a Path in Faron Woods in Twilight Princess Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Link carrying a lantern along a Faron Woods path in Twilight Princess, with his sword sheathed across his back beneath the cap. The lantern's crossed frame, chainmail edging, and patterned bracer add fine details, while broad tunic panels, tree trunks, and scattered rocks form larger sections.

pages.title: Link Casting a Fishing Rod at the Fishing Hole in Twilight Princess Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Link casting a fishing rod at the Fishing Hole in Twilight Princess, with the curved rod and lure raised above the water. A distant waterfall spills between rocky banks, while chainmail trim, belt buckles, conifers, and concentric water ripples add smaller details around Link's broad tunic.

pages.title: Link Snowboarding on a Frozen Leaf Down Snowpeak Coloring Page
pages.description: Link snowboards down Snowpeak on a frozen leaf in this printable coloring page, crouching with both arms spread as snow sprays around the pointed board. Strong leaf veins divide the riding surface, while his belt, bracers, trailing cap, and background conifers add details against the open snowy slope.

pages.title: Link Jumping Over a Dungeon Pit with Roc's Feather on Koholint Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Link jumping over a dungeon pit with Roc's Feather on Koholint Island, holding the large feather above his pointed cap. Spikes line the gap below his outstretched boots, while cracked masonry, a wall brazier, belt buckle, and shield outlines add separate details around the airborne figure.

pages.title: Link Wearing the Champion's Tunic and Checking the Sheikah Slate on the Great Plateau Coloring Page
pages.description: Link checks the Sheikah Slate on the Great Plateau in this printable coloring page, wearing the Champion's Tunic with a sword strapped across his back. The slate's eye symbol, patterned bracers, and belt buckles add fine sections, while broad clothing panels, nearby rocks, and distant ruined columns provide larger shapes.

pages.title: Link Using Recall to Ride a Fallen Rock Toward a Sky Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Link using Recall to ride a fallen rock toward a Sky Island, crouching with one hand extended above swirling motion bands. Cracks divide the floating boulder into broad faces, while patterned bracers, a sheathed sword, and distant island ruins add smaller details to the scene.

pages.title: Link Sitting with Kirby, Pikachu, and Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Link sits with Kirby, Pikachu, and Yoshi in this printable coloring page, balancing Kirby on his head while the others rest beside his crossed legs. Small star-shaped figures float around the group. Belts, boots, pointed ears, and layered clothing create varied sections on this coloring sheet, alongside the simpler rounded shapes of his companions.

pages.title: Zelda Link on Death Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Link appears on Death Mountain in this printable coloring page, shown in a close portrait with his pointed cap, shoulder strap, sword hilt, and shield visible. A flame-topped peak, jagged rocks, and scattered clouds fill the landscape behind him on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Link in Hyrule Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Link stands in Hyrule Castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, holding a decorated shield while resting his other hand near the hilt of his sword. Crenellated walls, an arched gate, a flag, and uneven paving create a fortress setting on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Link in Rito Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Link visits Rito Village in this printable coloring page, wearing a feather-trimmed shoulder cape with a shield behind him and a rectangular device at his belt. Curved wooden roof beams, a hanging basket, a bird-shaped ornament, and distant mountains frame this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Link at Sacred Spring Coloring Page
pages.description: Link stands at a sacred spring in this printable coloring page, wearing a short cloak over his tunic with a diagonal strap and small buckled pouches. Ripples, round-leaf plants, a small winged orb, broken columns, and carved stone patterns fill this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Link in Hebra Mountains Coloring Page
pages.description: Link travels through the Hebra Mountains in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy-trimmed cape, headband, and small braids beside his pointed ears and calm expression. A sword and shield rise behind his shoulders, with falling snow, fir trees, and peaks on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.
